name: Wind Crystal of Quintessence
description: A rare crystal imbued with elemental wind energy, required for constructing an airship.

name: Writs of Approval
description: Three writs of approval, from an engineers' guild, a masons' guild, and a guards' guild. Required for road construction or repair.

name: Spatial Navigator
description: A mystical device attuned to spatial magic, required for crafting a teleportation platform.

name: Simple Fishing Tackle
description: String, hook, and worm. Used for catching common freshwater fish. Project goal: 30.

name: Professional Fishing Tackle
description: Rod, reel, and lures. Used for catching sport fish and larger specimens. Project goal: 45.

name: Specialized Fishing Tackle
description: Nets, traps, and deep-water gear. Used for catching rare or exotic fish. Project goal: 60.

name: Magical Fishing Tackle
description: Enchanted lures and divination rods. Used for catching supernatural fish with special properties. Project goal: 90.

name: Common Cooking Ingredient
description: Flour, carrots, beef, and so forth. Used for perfecting modern recipes.

name: Key Cooking Ingredient
description: Starfruit, kindleseeds, oarfish, and so forth. Used for perfecting vintage or home recipes.

name: Rare Cooking Ingredient
description: Honeylilies, steel apples, and so forth. Rare or extinct ingredients used for perfecting ancient or lost recipes.
